name: South Korea
description: Korea from Gojoseon and the Three Kingdoms to Goryeo and Joseon, Japanese rule, the Korean War, the Miracle on the Han River and K-pop.

checkpoints.name: Ancient kingdoms
checkpoints.note: Gojoseon was the first Korean state. The Three Kingdoms of Goguryeo, Baekje and Silla followed, and Silla united most of the peninsula in the 600s.

checkpoints.name: Goryeo and Joseon
checkpoints.note: Goryeo, which gave Korea its name, carved the Tripitaka Koreana. The Joseon dynasty ruled from 1392, King Sejong created Hangul, and Admiral Yi beat back Japan in the 1590s.

checkpoints.name: Colony and war
checkpoints.note: Japan ruled Korea from 1910 to 1945. The peninsula was split at liberation, and the Korean War of 1950 to 1953 left it divided at the demilitarised zone.

checkpoints.name: Growth and democracy
checkpoints.note: Under Park Chung Hee the South grew fast. Protest won democracy in 1987, Seoul hosted the 1988 Olympics, and K-pop, films and series spread Korean culture worldwide.
